title: Enterprise Data Modeling: Relational, Vector, & Conversation State
description: Design high-performance, multi-tenant data structures for enterprise AI: EF Core entity modeling, vector embedding representations, conversation sessions, citations, document chunks, and audit logs.

data.text: Enterprise AI platforms require three distinct data storage paradigms: (1) Relational/Transactional storage for user accounts, tenancy boundaries, document metadata, and compliance audit logs; (2) Vector storage optimized for high-dimensional approximate nearest neighbor (ANN) similarity search; and (3) Semi-structured document storage for conversation state, tool execution traces, and grounded citations.

data.text: EF Core 9 Entity Definitions with pgvector

In .NET 9 with PostgreSQL and `Pgvector.EntityFrameworkCore`, high-dimensional vectors (e.g. 1536-dimensional OpenAI `text-embedding-3-small` or 3072-dimensional `text-embedding-3-large`) are mapped directly to strong C# types using `Pgvector.Vector`. Here is the core domain model.

data.title: DocumentChunk and Conversation Entities in C# 13
data.content: These domain entities enforce multi-tenant isolation, immutable chunk identifiers, and vector indexing configurations.

data.text: Vector searches must be filtered by tenant and security boundaries *before* or *during* nearest neighbor traversal. Combining HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) vector indexing with B-tree relational indexes on `TenantId` ensures sub-50ms search latency across millions of chunks.

data.title: Data Modeling Verification Checklist
items: TenantId foreign key enforced on all primary entities for mandatory tenant partitioning
Embedding dimensions explicitly pinned (1536 for small, 3072 for large) to prevent vector truncation
Security group ACLs stored as searchable arrays directly on chunk rows for single-pass filtered search
Cascade delete configured so deleting a parent document purges all child chunks and embeddings
Token counts and latency recorded on every message for accurate per-tenant cost accounting
Audit logs designed as append-only immutable records to comply with SOC2 / HIPAA standards

data.title: Summary & Next Steps
points: EnterpriseNexus models relational, vector, and semi-structured conversation state in harmony.
EF Core 9 with pgvector provides first-class LINQ support for vector cosine similarity queries.
HNSW indexing combined with tenant ACL pre-filtering ensures high-speed, secure retrieval.
Next, we design the hybrid retrieval pipeline (BM25 + HNSW + Reciprocal Rank Fusion).
data.takeaway: A robust data model is the bedrock of enterprise AI: tenant-level isolation, security ACLs, and vector indexing must be baked into the entity schema from day one.
